title: Antibacterial electrospun nanofibrous mats fabricated from polycaprolactone, gelatin and Synedrella nodiflora extract for biomedical applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,26320-26333
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01137C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Amanullah, Mainul Islam, Md. Mustafizur Rahman, Md. Farhad Hossain
Electrospun PCL/gelatin nanofibers incorporating Synedrella nodiflora extract showed enhanced antibacterial activity, controlled release, and improved moisture management, making them promising candidates for wound healing applications.
